## Current checkpoint — complete-graph rank and fixed-source renewal attempts

**Universal Collatz convergence and unrestricted original-source descent remain OPEN.** Every proposed complete proof still needs an actual meeting below the fixed original source, or a fixed-source mass contradiction. This pass tested full-graph Bellman ranks, functions of the complete finite binary word, and joint real/ternary renewal and conductance arguments. Three GPT-6.2 Astra agents worked on the direct targets. The required global implication was not proved.

- Scientific source: 71bedad6b44b35389d3a237e307e8286c11efcb5
- Verified publication head: 301b84491ffafe283bd63d104c1b60ddf0e97f06
- Final tree: 3cd3136c8243757914ce8f863e1fc5b413293c6c
- [Complete account](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/301b84491ffafe283bd63d104c1b60ddf0e97f06/research/astra-two-centre-20261124/README.md) · [Root review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/301b84491ffafe283bd63d104c1b60ddf0e97f06/reports/astra-two-centre-20261124/ROOT_REVIEW.md) · [Verification](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/301b84491ffafe283bd63d104c1b60ddf0e97f06/reports/astra-two-centre-20261124/VERIFICATION.md)

### Positive estimate and the remaining global step

For edge cost c(x,y)=1/max(bitlength(x),bitlength(y)), the proper Bellman envelope with stopping cost 3 floor(log2 x) equals actual forward cost to 1 on every x <= 1,000,000, including comparison against all possible targets outside the tested interval. This is exact finite evidence, not an all-source bound.

A written, independently reviewed argument proves that an injective visit to [X,3X), X a positive integer, lasts at most 3 ceil(log2(2X))-1 edges and costs at most 4. Staying in that interval forces parity by size, the partial map preserves cyclic order, and at most 2h parity words can stay for h steps. Exact parity coding identifies the ordinary starts. The attempted projection across multiple bands reverses cyclic order on an explicit ordinary orbit. Repeated returns and upward moves have not been charged to the original source.

The ordered-gap argument also excludes cycles with max <= 3 min except 1,2. This overlaps the mechanical/high-cycle class excluded by Knight; no priority or all-cycle claim is made. [Graph and rank argument](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/301b84491ffafe283bd63d104c1b60ddf0e97f06/research/astra-two-centre-20261124/rewriting.md)

### Direct global candidates tested

- A mixed binary/ternary input proves that no positive finite-residue rank n^s w(n mod M), with a fixed finite repertoire of full-graph moves, strictly improves every sufficiently large ordinary input. Exact affine offsets are included. The mixed input is nonordinary; its positive approximants change with depth.
- Exact positive sums of genuine finite trajectories reject additive binary blocks of width <= 6, arbitrary positional/length weights on those blocks, and a separate template using any linear functional of two arbitrary real 2-by-2 digit matrices. Generic matrix-entry polynomial coefficients cancel exactly. Combining templates or increasing their expressive power remains open.
- The complete graph peak certificate applies to every n=9663+7342984060644141028475928576 t, t>=0: every path to a smaller positive integer visits at least 1024n. Arbitrarily large excursions remain allowed.
- Conditional on the pinned unmarked seed-image volume bound and PR200 reverse-prefix estimate, the marked ratio-five joint law is purely singular, ruling out the proposed finite-volume tile. This does not settle absolute continuity of the ternary projection. Fixed-cohort transport preserves a relative gap from the diagonal. The conductance and antichain calculations do not give nonsummable side leakage.

[Finite-input arguments](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/301b84491ffafe283bd63d104c1b60ddf0e97f06/research/astra-two-centre-20261124/integer.md) · [Finite-word rank certificates](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/301b84491ffafe283bd63d104c1b60ddf0e97f06/research/astra-two-centre-20261124/digit_rank.md) · [Renewal and conductance](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/301b84491ffafe283bd63d104c1b60ddf0e97f06/research/astra-two-centre-20261124/basin.md)

### Verification scope

Fresh source replay at 71bedad6b44b35389d3a237e307e8286c11efcb5: two Std-only Lean modules compiled with warnings as errors, eight named axiom audits, and four exact Python controls each run normally and under -O with identical output. The finite peak tree uses kernel decide and no axioms; the remaining declarations use only standard propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound as listed. Written analytic and topological arguments retain their explicit scope.

- Fresh receipt SHA-256: 8d8dd8ed2d7eba04461b4d25c267f0a1c6a0b266fe3eeef2aff0e4ad0a78d0bc.
- Final complete-checkout validator passed at 301b84491ffafe283bd63d104c1b60ddf0e97f06: 590 tracked files.
- Final validator receipt SHA-256: 6704e5d605efcda8f49396b4af0e3c030adfb4d8dbe738af3b9dfd5ae4ad9cac.
- Scientific source manifest matches the fresh receipt after the receipt-only successor.
- PR195, PR200 and PR202 heads rechecked and pinned in [SOURCES.json](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/301b84491ffafe283bd63d104c1b60ddf0e97f06/reports/astra-two-centre-20261124/SOURCES.json); upstream formal developments were not rebuilt.

The exact outstanding bound is the accumulated harmonic cost of all actual prefixes from one ordinary source, or a different total original-floor merger. The local estimates and rejected templates do not discharge it.

## Current checkpoint — direct fixed-source closure attempt

**Universal Collatz convergence remains OPEN.** This pass tested whether unrestricted inverse histories or adaptive paths in the ordinary component graph force a meeting below the original source. That implication was not proved. Three GPT-6.2 Astra agents developed and independently reviewed the attempts.

- Science commit: 29d61ae09fa4b67641725248ee77f87d29c5e1fb
- Published verification head: 3868f83ed8fab67ea1bcb28312a288ca96c7dc5f
- Final tree: 245fe654920863afef008b2952c89732dbb47d56
- [Complete account](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3868f83ed8fab67ea1bcb28312a288ca96c7dc5f/research/astra-fixed-atom-20261124/README.md) · [Review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3868f83ed8fab67ea1bcb28312a288ca96c7dc5f/reports/astra-fixed-atom-20261124/ROOT_REVIEW.md) · [Verification](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3868f83ed8fab67ea1bcb28312a288ca96c7dc5f/reports/astra-fixed-atom-20261124/VERIFICATION.md)

### What the Lean kernel checks

1. For every positive source b < 703, every visitor clock j >= 0, and every shortcut clock i < 81, T^j(b) differs from T^i(703). At clock 81, T^81(703) = 628. A kernel-checked finite forward-closed set containing 1 through 702 proves the statement for **all visitor clocks**. The independent complete hull has 1,106 elements and maximum 20,762. [Certificate](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3868f83ed8fab67ea1bcb28312a288ca96c7dc5f/research/astra-fixed-atom-20261124/finite_certificate.lean)
2. Every critical shifted input a = 6k+2 admits at most three adaptive switches to a state with a smaller positive same-component partner. The strict comparison is with the **reached state**. The theorem supplies no universal comparison with the original input. [Proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3868f83ed8fab67ea1bcb28312a288ca96c7dc5f/research/astra-fixed-atom-20261124/termination.lean) · [Mathematics](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3868f83ed8fab67ea1bcb28312a288ca96c7dc5f/research/astra-fixed-atom-20261124/termination.md)

The 703 theorem excludes smaller origins reaching the stated prefix. It does not exclude a component comparison using a later common future; the clock-81 equality supplies one explicitly.

### Testing the missing cumulative argument

A written all-horizon pressure calculation for the specified controller bounds the ternary Haar measure of inputs admitting any finite path with cumulative homogeneous multiplier at most one by 31/32. A modified bound accounts for affine offsets before a first decrease at a tested boundary or exit. This rejects a universal ternary-input repayment argument for these switches. It supplies no positive integer that fails forever and covers only the listed controller. [All-round test](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3868f83ed8fab67ea1bcb28312a288ca96c7dc5f/research/astra-fixed-atom-20261124/controller_pressure.md)

The unrestricted inverse-cost calculation allows h greater than t with no cutoff and proves z < 2^D H(m). A fixed overhead therefore eventually reuses finitely many origins. The density lane retains the fixed positive basin floor of a hypothetical escaping source, but does not produce nonsummable side-branch mass. [Attempt and dependencies](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3868f83ed8fab67ea1bcb28312a288ca96c7dc5f/research/astra-fixed-atom-20261124/arithmetic.md)

### Verification and latest intake

Fresh replay on the real, clean science commit passed seven named Std-only Lean declarations with Lean 4.34.1, warnings as errors, and only standard axioms. The exact clock-81 equality has no axioms. Normal and optimized Python controls agreed. No native evaluation bridge or proof admission is used. The infinite pressure argument and imported density results are written mathematics.

[Replay receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3868f83ed8fab67ea1bcb28312a288ca96c7dc5f/reports/astra-fixed-atom-20261124/fresh_replay/receipt.json): SHA-256 fd4b5a52d7b0f93034819cd96126a39b2e8784523fd370249e3c0cbcd16414e9.

Final validation receipt SHA-256: 5a8e8695175412fbef2ebb23097b037760524a986f86fb0cd07a300fc9e8c669. This is repository integrity validation, not verification of Collatz.

The final recheck read PR193 at 5f160a843750f209ea1251dfb01ea0b23e532fd6 and PR201 at 084b983fbec6f3d2120ef101946754431f82874e; PR197, PR195 and PR182 were unchanged from the pinned intake. Their remaining full-meeting mass and fixed-source gaps stay explicit. ## Current pass: unrestricted ordinary step

**Collatz remains OPEN. This pass did not prove the closing implication.** Three GPT-6.2 Astra agents attacked the full inverse minimum, the joint real/ternary survivor kernel, and a positive ordinary transfer certificate. A second round extended the one positive kernel estimate to different words and tested whether it could cover a fixed hypothetical escaping source.

Scientific checkpoint: `d75b5235691bc2cee50833a7b776cd28f3e22c0c`  
Published head with replay records: `5720732b9c83361f5cded4f8bfac24e36f469937`

[Research packet](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/5720732b9c83361f5cded4f8bfac24e36f469937/research/astra-universal-step-20261124/README.md) · [Written proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/5720732b9c83361f5cded4f8bfac24e36f469937/research/astra-universal-step-20261124/descent.md) · [Fixed-source test](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/5720732b9c83361f5cded4f8bfac24e36f469937/research/astra-universal-step-20261124/arithmetic.md) · [Verification](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/5720732b9c83361f5cded4f8bfac24e36f469937/reports/astra-universal-step-20261124/VERIFICATION.md)

### Positive estimate, with its exact restriction

For s=7/4 and t=101/100, the summed normalized inverse Green contribution from two specified carry classes is at most **10^15 y^(-1/200)** at every positive integer endpoint y that is not itself on a cycle. All lengths are included, as are arbitrary flanks of combined length at most h/25.

The first class consists of two length-h blocks with the same odd count and matching carries; their words can differ. The second consists of arbitrary length-kh histories, k>=3, whose total odd count and carry residue match a k-fold reference word. The reference need not occur in the history. The proof uses exact integer divisibility, carry injectivity, weighted finite norms and a summable interpolation bound. This is written mathematics; the Lean modules certify its named finite arithmetic interfaces.

### The proposed bridge fails at a fixed source

For a nonreturning actual pair with matched carries, block length h and initial value x, the arithmetic forces
`(4/3)^v < x+1` and `h < 7 log_2(x+1)`.
With a prefix flank of length at most h/25 from fixed b, this gives
`h < (175/18) log_2(b+1)`.

Consequently compulsory arbitrarily long matching pairs cannot make the estimate cover the escaping contribution from one fixed source. The full inverse-minimum test did not supply a cheaper ordinary competitor. **The unmatched-history estimate and stationary-cycle exclusion are both still missing.** No equivalent criterion or finite optimality window is presented as their proof.

The joint singular-kernel attempt controls deep fractional denominators but leaves the integer survivor with coefficient one. Rational preimages of every fixed endpoint have a proved harmonic-mass lower bound; their conversion to ordinary preimages incurs an uncontrolled 4^t factor. The positive smoothing construction likewise has no proved parameter range providing both ordinary decay and strict surplus.

## Current checkpoint: attack the universal obstruction

**Collatz remains OPEN.** The final work in this checkpoint directly targets a globally least positive odd nonconverger. It does not establish the smaller-source meeting required by induction, or the vanishing estimate in the universal moment criterion below. The restricted descent results are retained with their actual hypotheses.

**Published head:** `045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9`  
**Tree:** `e55fec0072bc4286bd160fb8657b2e1a2aca9607`  
**Scientific source checkpoint:** `182a44fac3567d8bf1a450935d64d7ffe52593e6`

[Scientific overview](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9/research/astra-high-variance-20261124/README.md) · [Direct universal attempt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9/research/astra-high-variance-20261124/CENTRAL_CLOSURE.md) · [Coordinating review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9/research/astra-high-variance-20261124/ROOT_REVIEW.md) · [Fresh execution record](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9/reports/astra-high-variance-20261124/README.md)

### 1. A full ordinary closing criterion, including cycles

For independent positive gaps with probability proportional to 2 to the power minus s times the gap, s>1, retain both the exact ternary endpoint residue and the same word's real affine carry. The shifted negative moment Z_N(s) converges exactly to the sum of x^(-s) over every positive odd source x that never reaches one.

Thus vanishing of this explicit moment is equivalent to full Collatz convergence, with no favorable-language assumption and no nontrivial-cycle exception. This is a written equivalence, **not a proof of vanishing**. Every fixed surviving source contributes exactly x^(-s) through a single word at every sufficiently large depth, even though that word is exponentially rare under the independent law. A bulk Fourier estimate, Haar-average contraction or removal of rare words does not control the missing contribution.

The attempted full-class inverse transfer has favorable averaged contraction. Its natural Green supersolution fails the necessary global summability because it retains a fixed original ancestor at every later level. A continuous residue-only supersolution is also ruled out by the negative fixed point and its dense ternary predecessors. Height-dependent certificates remain a separate possibility.

[Complete argument and failed estimates](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9/research/astra-high-variance-20261124/CENTRAL_CLOSURE.md) · [Finite Lean criterion and lift identity](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9/research/astra-high-variance-20261124/central_closure.lean)

### 2. Original-floor return and inverse optimization

The new PR193 forward-anchor theorem supplies an actual forward value y in the image of the critical section. Its least one-step odd predecessor is below the original least bad m exactly when y is 2 modulo 3 and y<(3m+1)/2. The entrance theorem supplies neither that joint residue/absolute-height condition nor another universally smaller source. A critical lift can quarter-reduce exactly back to the original minimum, with zero strict saving.

A simultaneous CRT construction gives actual finite prefixes avoiding **every** smaller ancestor through specified forward and inverse horizons, with all competing gaps unrestricted. The source changes with the horizon; no infinite counterexample is inferred.

In the L/P sector, an explicit total reciprocal budget makes each distinct prefix of a globally least bad input an exact minimum of the binary clock among all ordinary inverse words of the same odd depth. The first paid gap need not violate this condition: an all-r signed argument reduces all shorter competitors to 35 finite starting magnitudes. No eventual violation, full geodesic classification, or exhaustive reduction to L/P has been proved.

[Direct return attempt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9/research/astra-high-variance-20261124/CENTRAL_RETURN.md) · [All-depth inverse test](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9/research/astra-high-variance-20261124/CENTRAL_DESCENT.md) · [Exact signed control](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9/research/astra-high-variance-20261124/central_descent.py)

### 3. Positive ordinary descent retained with its coverage

For L=(2,1), P=(1,4), every initial length-five header beginning P is now covered when followed by arbitrary paid runs separated by at least seven L blocks. Initial L runs have arbitrary length. The construction produces a positive odd nonconverger below the original boundary and its first light intermediate where present. Three adjustable comparison profiles cover the old residual headers. Paid-run lengths and their number are unbounded; short intercluster gaps remain outside this theorem.

A separate construction uses four-light buffers after a more restricted entrance. The five-macro core is checked in Lean; the all-header and unbounded-run extensions have independently reviewed written proofs with exact finite certificates.

[All-header theorem](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9/research/astra-high-variance-20261124/DESCENT_ALL_HEADERS.md) · [Unbounded paid-run proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9/research/astra-high-variance-20261124/DESCENT_PAID_RUNS.md) · [Lean core](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9/research/astra-high-variance-20261124/descent_macro.lean)

### 4. One-source transport and quantitative analytic work

The packet also supplies equal-odd-clock mixed mergers, a delayed residual return that advances on one original orbit, and one summable correction budget for all synchronized replacement paths. Every member of the retained marked residual set has first odd gap at most two. The written phase argument gives effective O((1+log n)^(17/4)) marked visitation and O(N^(-4/25)) discrepancy with unevaluated constants. These facts do not supply recurrence or a universally strict rank.

Latest focused intake includes PR182 f5e65db, PR193 d35bdfd, PR197 9ed095c and PR188 f0e3cd9. Twenty-one repository inputs and the inspected primary literature have exact pins in [SOURCES.json](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9/research/astra-high-variance-20261124/SOURCES.json). Upstream claims keep their stated evidence levels; their Lean builds are not counted here.

- Fresh compilation of **five Std-only Lean modules**, Lean 4.34.1, one worker, warnings as errors.
- **Fourteen named transitive axiom audits**, all subsets of propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
- **Seven exact Python controls**, each run normally and with optimization; identical paired stdout/stderr.
- Recorded controls include 25,797 physical source pairs, 8,184 inverse prefixes, 16,383 literal rewrites, 484 joint gluing traces, all profile entrance/reset certificates and the complete signed finite control.
- Clean full-checkout validation on the published science commit: all five default commands passed; source hashes, head, tree and clean status unchanged.
- Independent lane reviews and a coordinating reconstruction distinguish written, Lean-checked, finite and still-open assertions.
- The exact final head above also passed all five default repository-integrity commands in a clean **522-file** checkout. The final commit adds receipts and updates the report; tested research sources are unchanged. Optional historical regressions were not rerun.

[Source-hashed replay receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9/reports/astra-high-variance-20261124/fresh_replay/receipt.json) · [Independent arithmetic review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9/research/astra-high-variance-20261124/ARITHMETIC_REVIEW.md) · [Independent rewriting review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/045be43632f274dd64faf15714e42cc8de27a2e9/research/astra-high-variance-20261124/REWRITING_REVIEW.md)
